title: Paper → reproduction benchmark. Resolve a publication from a title / URL / DOI / PMID / author+journal+year, harvest its Data Availability statement + accessions from the full text, route them onto an IGVFagent analysis chain, and scaffold a runnable Benchmarks/<paper-id>/ that concordance.py scores. Subcommands: resolve, harvest, route, scaffold, run, score, report, pipeline, selftest, list-routes.
